🎉 Barcelona · Wed 18 Nov

TODAY · Wed 18 Nov

1. BRESH CLUB
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 Sala Apolo
📊 1 interested on RA · also on DICE
💶 From €15.50
💬 The Argentine party brand's weekly Wednesday at Apolo: pop, reggaeton and throwback hits, glitter and a largely Argentine and Latin crowd. A dancing night to bring friends to, and easy to meet people at.
https://ra.co/events/2574198

2. Electrostad: FREE PARTY with INOFF, Victor Hugo & friends
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 Chica Club
📊 202 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free house and electronic club night from a local collective at Chica Club. The biggest headcount of tonight's club listings and no cover, so an easy second stop.
https://ra.co/events/2554893

3. Afterwork AperiBarcelona: conoce gente nueva 🍹
🕘 Tonight 18:30 → 22:30 · 📍 Sant Antoni
📊 110 guests on Luma
💶 Free
💬 Italian-style aperitivo afterwork run by the city's Italian community, built for meeting new people over a drink. Early start, so it works before a club.
https://luma.com/gyu8kuiw

4. Storytelling Barcelona – "Courage"
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 21:30 · 📍 El Noa Noa
📊 89 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 718 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Monthly English-language live storytelling night, this month on the theme of courage. Nearly at its limit, so RSVP before going.
https://www.meetup.com/storytelling-barcelona/events/317013620/

5. Housy at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 33 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 House music on the 26th floor of the W hotel with views over the city and the sea. Free with guest list, finishes at 2, a dressier option than the clubs.
https://ra.co/events/2569449

TOMORROW · Thu 19 Nov

1. Rituals pres. Pfirter + Insen + Kala Ros + PILIGN + Daija Showcase
🕘 Thu 18:00 → 22:30 · 📍 Bridge 48
📊 183 interested on RA
💬 Early-evening techno in Poblenou: four DJs, an hour each, playing in the round with the crowd dancing around them. Headlined by Buenos Aires DJ Pfirter and done by 22:30.
https://ra.co/events/2574978

2. PUTUTU: evento benéfico Perú
🕘 Thu 20:00 → 03:00 · 📍 Meteoro
📊 41 interested on RA · RA Pick
💶 €10
💬 Benefit night for Peru with six DJs playing techno and Latin bass, picked by Resident Advisor's editors. Starts at 20:00 and runs late.
https://ra.co/events/2576266

3. Comedy, Conversation & Matcha
🕘 Thu 18:30 → 21:00 · 📍 Charcha | Specialty Coffee | Wine & Art
📊 46 going on Meetup (limit 50) · group has 1,998 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Six stand-up comedians in a cosy cafe, with time to chat before and after. Almost full, so RSVP early. A low-key way to meet people.
https://www.meetup.com/charcha-cultural-cafe/events/317210312/

4. Recreo presents: Nuremberg connection
🕘 Thu 21:00 → 03:00 · 📍 Recreo Bar
📊 80 interested on RA
💶 Free
💬 Free techno and electro bar night with two DJs, from 21:00. Good for drinks with friends that turn into dancing.
https://ra.co/events/2557233

5. Data Science in Production: Multi-Objective ML & AI-Driven ML Lifecycles
🕘 Thu 18:30 → 20:30 · 📍 Carrer de Llull, 110
📊 37 going on Meetup (limit 170) · group has 5,827 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Tech talks at Glovo's HQ on running machine learning in production, with plenty of room left. The place to meet Barcelona's engineers and data people.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-tech-talks/events/317268956/
